external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Since 2023, Andrea has been a visiting lecturer within the Bachelor of Science in Diving Safety Management programme run by the Institute of Tourism Studies (ITS) in Malta.

B.E.A. (Buoy Eau Air) was a research collaboration between Divers Code Malta and the University of Malta’s Institute of Aerospace Technologies. The project investigated a coordinated system of vehicles operating in the air, on the surface and underwater to help monitor divers and warn them about hazards.
